name: Heka
reason: Riset hanya personifikasi magic/medicine dan peran membutakan buaya, tanpa rupa Heka atau bentuk manifestasi visual spesifik. Menggambar humanoid Mesir, senjata atau sinar akan mengarang; buaya buta saja tanpa dewa gagal subjek.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
artistic_choices: Tidak mengarang anatomi/efek di luar klaim; tidak ada panggilan gambar untuk entri ini.
